turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and did anyone hear Owen first?
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
You had time to enter a zero before you had time to call me.
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Then show me something besides a machine's guess.
